name: Pixel Art: Location Exterior
description: Image preset for a location exterior in the Pixel Art look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an exterior establishing shot. Name the location's defining structure, surroundings, time of day, and weather from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: wide exterior establishing view of the location, clear foreground, midground and background, a sense of scale from a figure or doorway, pixel art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited 16 to 32 colour palette, readable silhouette at low resolution, no anti-aliasing, deliberate dithering, single consistent light direction, high-contrast outline against the background
negative_prompt: smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, blur, photorealistic, 3d render, mixed pixel sizes, text, watermark
